tools.name: scan_url
tools.description: Scan a skill/MCP server by URL for security issues. Returns risk level, findings, and verdict.

params.name: url
params.description: URL of the skill file or MCP server to scan

tools.name: scan_github
tools.description: Scan a GitHub repository for skill files and security issues.

params.name: repo
params.description: GitHub repository in owner/name format (e.g. modelcontextprotocol/servers)

tools.name: gate_check
tools.description: Pre-install gate check. Returns allow/warn/deny decision for a skill URL.

params.name: url
params.description: URL of the skill to check

params.name: threshold
params.description: Risk threshold (default: moderate). Deny if risk >= threshold.

tools.name: reputation_check
tools.description: Check the reputation of a domain based on aggregated scan history.
